# OurMoney

> The first finance app built specifically for couples. A shared household budget, fair expense splitting, privacy.

OurMoney is a Progressive Web App (PWA) that lets couples track expenses together,
manage a monthly budget and work towards shared savings goals.

## Key features
- Smart expense splitting (50/50, proportional to income, custom)
- Mine-Yours-Ours - separate private and shared spaces
- Shared financial goals (holidays, renovation, house deposit)
- AI-generated monthly reports and analysis
- PWA - works like a native app on any device

## Pricing
- Free plan: 0 PLN forever, no credit card and no trial period. Unlimited expenses and
  income, shared budget for two people, all splitting modes, goals and envelopes.
  Limits: shortened transaction history, limited custom categories, 1 bank statement
  import per month, 5 receipt scans per month, no AI analysis, no bank integration.
- Premium: 39.99 PLN per month or 399.99 PLN per year (2 months free). Removes every
  limit of the free plan and adds monthly AI analysis with recommendations plus
  automatic bank integration.

## Positioning
A simple alternative to spreadsheets, with real partner support.
Broader than Splitwise (a full budget, not just debt settlement) and simpler than YNAB.
